question: Should imported issue-only clusters be allowed to close clear duplicates without first producing a code-fix artifact, while PR-containing and security-sensitive clusters remain fix-first?
rationale: Tests establish the implementation mechanics, but accepting a deliberately weaker pre-close gate for autonomous issue cleanup is a repository safety-policy choice that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after bounded canary
options.body: Run one issue-only duplicate canary through the full guarded pipeline, then merge if only the intended duplicate close becomes eligible.

options.title: Keep universal fix-first gating
options.body: Leave the existing conservative behavior in place so any imported autonomous cluster with fix or merge capability must establish a fix path before closing duplicates.

options.title: Add explicit importer opt-in
options.body: Expose the issue-only relaxation as an explicit job-generation option so operators choose it per batch rather than changing the default.

recommendation.title: Accept after bounded canary
recommendation.body: Run one issue-only duplicate canary through the full guarded pipeline, then merge if only the intended duplicate close becomes eligible.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed cluster-import policy change and have clear domain ownership beyond merely opening this PR.
